binary_close_mechanism.method: buy opposite outcome then merge complete pair
binary_close_mechanism.reason: Historical gas conditions for merge transactions are not available in H2-v1.

decision_framework.overall_language: Report positive or negative historical print-supported economic proxy separately from demonstrated live tradeability.
decision_framework.reason: H2-v1 lacks historical bid/ask quotes and depth, so trade prints cannot prove hypothetical executable fills.

economic_metrics.reason: M7 is economic/execution characterization following the frozen M6 hypothesis test, not a new significance search.

execution_data_limit.interpretation: Executed taker prints support a historical execution proxy but do not prove that our own order would have filled at that price or size.

fee_contract.merge_fee: not modeled as a Polymarket trading fee
fee_contract.source: market-specific feeSchedule audited across all 42 frozen H2-v1 markets
fee_contract.terminology: platform-fee-adjusted net proxy; not fully net realized PnL

market_execution_constraints.interpretation: A >=5-share historical print demonstrates that such a trade size occurred, not that our hypothetical order would necessarily have received the same fill.
market_execution_constraints.primary_liquidity_support: both historical BUY prints must each have size >=5 shares

non_goals: Do not alter signal horizons after observing PnL.
Do not alter action latency after observing PnL.
Do not alter the 300-second primary hedge cap after observing PnL.
Do not promote sharp-gap secondary evidence to primary.
Do not claim RN1 was live-actionable in H2-v1.
Do not infer historical spread or order-book depth from prints.
Do not invent merge gas costs.
Do not claim realized or deployable profitability from this proxy.

rn1_oracle.entry_second_policy: exclude the entire RN1 signal second
rn1_oracle.reason: 0/213 frozen RN1 fills were captured by the historical collector within 3600 seconds of venue event_time.
rn1_oracle.signal_population: M6 RN1 same-second clustered +30s broad population

scientific_question: Conditional on the frozen H2-v1 signals, is there historical print-supported economic edge after Polymarket platform taker fees?

close.selection: first matching taker BUY print at or after signal_time + 60s

entry.selection: first matching taker BUY print at or after signal_time + 10s

sharp_primary.reason_for_300s_execution_cap: Chosen before PnL using execution coverage only. A 60s hedge cap leaves only 10 >=5-share trades across 10 markets, while 300s retains 20 across 17 markets. The predictive target remains +60s.
sharp_primary.signal_population: M6 nonzero sharp innovation +60s broad population
